page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the e2 family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, utilizing an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations position this instance in the lower performance tiers. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1103.39, while the multi-core score is 1451.58. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with read-only large block speeds at 11.77 GB/sec and write speeds at 10.27 GB/sec. Computational benchmarks like Geekbench reflect similar trends, yielding a single-core score of 867.0 and a multi-core score of 1025.0.

Given the lower-tier performance metrics across database operations, text processing, and web serving, the e2-standard-2 is best suited for lightweight, non-critical workloads. These include basic web serving, small-scale development or testing environments, and low-throughput background tasks. The primary tradeoff is its low computational and memory throughput in exchange for a highly cost-efficient resource profile, making it a viable option for budget-conscious deployments that do not require high-performance hardware.
